title: 2. Update the source designs and brand guidelines
description:
Use the decisions recorded in step 1 to make the design sources the reference for implementation.

Tasks:
- Update design/system/README.md and the Sticker and LoopBand component guidance to distinguish the wordmark card, the stationary editorial description and the two band phrases.
- Update the relevant current homepage/card artboards under design/canvas/ and their index only as needed. Preserve historical alternatives as history rather than rewriting them as the new design.
- Show the approved card and the description immediately below it, before Latest posts, with both Day and Night treatments.
- Document the exact horizontal band wording and order: first "Information About Information Systems", second "Machines on Machines". Each band repeats only its assigned phrase.
- Follow the existing Ink blue palette, Anton/Archivo type, spacing, shapes and wordmark. Use the existing tokens and asset-generation workflow; do not edit generated tokens.css by hand.
- Follow the repository's artifact publication procedure if the canonical design artifacts need refreshing, and record the resulting references for implementation.

Complete when the current design sources and guidelines agree with step 1 and provide an unambiguous implementation reference. This is branding work, not a new visual identity.

comments.text: Done: design/system/README.md, the LoopBand and Sticker READMEs, and band 1 in design/canvas/F-Home.dc.html. The sentence isn't drawn in the canvas artboard, and the published design artifacts aren't republished yet; ask Ryan.
